profile.name: 罗德与施瓦茨网络测试仪器
profile.description: 通过以太网 Socket/VISA 接口通信的罗德与施瓦茨电子测试仪器。该类设备通常用于实验室中的远程配置、状态查询、数据读取和自动化测量，常见于射频与通用电子测试场景。
profile.description_en: A Rohde & Schwarz electronic test instrument that communicates through an Ethernet socket/VISA interface. Such instruments are commonly used in laboratories for remote configuration, status queries, data readout, and automated measurements in RF and general electronic test setups.
